item.title: “Works Every Time”: 36 Underrated Plane Perks You Should Start Taking Advantage Of
item.description: Flying may have once felt magical, but for many people now, it’s a pretty mundane way to get around. The usual airport routine—security, passport control, and duty-free—is familiar territory. What many passengers may not know, though, is that there are plenty of small ways to make travel smoother and more comfortable. That’s why flight attendants and seasoned travelers on Reddit shared insider tips and lesser-known perks people can use on their next flight. Here are some of the best ones.

item.title: 85 Hilariously Absurd Movie And TV Details That Are Absolutely Made Up, Yet Weirdly Accurate (New Pics)
item.description: Satire doesn’t always land well, especially when expressed through text where emotions are lacking. It may cause confusion in some people, particularly those who take things too literally. Fortunately, we have this subreddit where millions of people enjoy sharing sarcastic comments about famous movies and TV shows.

item.title: “What Are These Board Directors Thinking?”: 117 Hilarious Pics Of Cats Gathering Together
item.description: Cats may act independent, but anyone with more than one knows they occasionally assemble like tiny, furry executives. The Council of Cats page highlights these mysterious “meetings,” capturing moments that make you wonder what exactly is on their agenda.

item.description: Almost every high school has that guy. Parents, teachers, and coaches admire him. Most others have a crush on him. item.title: 69 Nature Pics That Are As Interesting As They Are Beautiful
item.description: Frost patterns on a windscreen that might impress the most renowned realism painters. Flowers that look like 3D-rendered chickens auditioning for a Disney movie... Every inch of nature holds a piece of magic. Here are some of the most interesting photos people have captured in the wild.

item.title: Woman Accuses Husband’s Ex-SIL Of Not Liking Her When She Gets Asked To Show More Respect
item.description: One woman shared how her husband’s brother’s ex repeatedly made plans involving her home without asking, from surprise stays to trips she expected others to fund. After years of staying quiet, she finally spoke up and asked for one simple thing: to be asked first. What followed was an emotional fallout that left her questioning whether she had crossed a line.

item.title: 108 Terrible Product Designs That Should Have Never Seen The Light Of Day (New Pics)
item.description: Design is meant to solve problems, whether they’re functional, aesthetic, or both. But sometimes, instead of making things better, it creates even more problems than it fixes. This subreddit dedicated to design fails is full of examples, and some of them are so bad they almost circle back to being good. They also raise plenty of questions about how they ever got approved, but at least they’re entertaining to look at.

item.title: 55 Things Patients Do To Help Their Doctors And Nurses But They Have An Opposite Effect
item.description: Family members answering instead of letting the patient talk. Hoarding antibiotics in case you might need them later. Not knowing that an allergy is more serious than a simple side effect. These are just some of the ways patients try to be helpful to doctors and nurses that actually have the opposite effect. Read on to find out perhaps you, too, have a habit that makes a doctor's job harder rather than easier.

item.title: 57 Unhinged Group Chat Messages That Went Off The Rails Fast
item.description: Group chats are what keep our phones alive, no matter how far their members might be from each other in the real world. Whether it’s your family who take down their masks in front of one another, or colleagues constantly spilling the latest office tea, GCs have a way of going completely sideways. item.title: “1 In 2,000,000”: 46 Animals With Rare Genetic Mutations That Don’t Even Look Real (New Pics)
item.description: Genes are short sections of DNA that determine an animal’s traits—everything from coat color and claw strength to body shape and health. But sometimes, these genes mutate. And while the word itself sounds alarming, most mutations are harmless and invisible. The more noticeable ones, however, can produce features that are quite rare for the species.
